title: Pure Psy-Frame
summary: PSY-Frame is a unique LIGHT Psychic handtrap-Synchro control archetype where every Level 1–2 'PSY-Framegear' Tuner (Gamma, Delta, Epsilon, Alpha, and Beta) can only be Special Summoned while you control NO monsters and your opponent performs a specific action—summoning both the PSY-Framegear Tuner AND Level 6 Normal Monster PSY-Frame Driver from your hand, Deck, or GY to negate the opponent's play! Activate the Field Spell PSY-Frame Circuit so that the moment a PSY-Framegear resolves on your opponent's turn, Circuit immediately Synchro Summons Level 7 PSY-Framelord Zeta or high-impact Synchros (like Black Rose Dragon or F.A. Dawn Dragster), while Link-2 PSY-Framelord Lambda unlocks your handtraps even while you control monsters!

allow.Psychic Feel Zone: Normal Spell that targets 1 of your banished Psychic Tuners and 1 of your banished Psychic non-Tuners, returns both to the GY, and Special Summons a Psychic Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck!
allow.Hop Ear Squadron: Level 2 WIND Beast Tuner handtrap that Special Summons itself during your opponent's Main Phase and immediately Synchro Summons using a lingering PSY-Frame Driver on your field!
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches the essential PSY-Frame Circuit Field Spell.
allow.Black Rose Dragon: Level 7 Synchro that can be Synchro Summoned during your opponent's turn via PSY-Frame Circuit (using Level 1 PSY-Framegear Alpha/Beta + Level 6 Driver) to nuke the entire field on the opponent's turn!
allow.F.A. Dawn Dragster: Level 7 LIGHT Machine Synchro (Level 1 Alpha/Beta + Level 6 Driver) that negates an opponent's Spell/Trap Card or effect as a Quick Effect!
allow.Draco Berserker of the Tenyi: Level 8 Synchro that banishes an opponent's monster that activates its effect as a Quick Effect!
allow.Scarlight Red Dragon Archfiend: Level 8 DARK Dragon Synchro that destroys all Special Summoned monsters on the field with ATK less than or equal to its own and burns for each!

main: PSY-Frame Driver
Core Level 6 LIGHT Psychic Normal Monster (2500 ATK): required in your hand, Deck, or GY for every single PSY-Framegear handtrap to Special Summon alongside itself and tune into Synchros!
PSY-Frame Multi-Threader

Level 6 LIGHT Psychic: treated as 'PSY-Frame Driver' while in hand or GY; protects PSY-Frame cards from destruction by discarding itself; and revives itself from GY whenever a PSY-Frame Tuner is Special Summoned!
PSY-Framegear Gamma
Limited to 1 in TCG: Level 2 Tuner handtrap that negates and destroys an opponent's monster effect when activated while you control no monsters, summoning itself and Driver!
PSY-Framegear Delta
Level 2 Tuner handtrap: when your opponent activates a Spell Card/effect while you control no monsters, negates the activation and destroys it, summoning itself and Driver!
PSY-Framegear Epsilon
Level 2 Tuner handtrap: when your opponent activates a Trap Card/effect while you control no monsters, negates the activation and destroys it, summoning itself and Driver!
PSY-Framegear Alpha
Core Level 1 Tuner handtrap: when your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster while you control no monsters, Special Summons itself and Driver AND adds ANY 'PSY-Frame' card from Deck to hand!
PSY-Framegear Beta
Level 1 Tuner handtrap: when an opponent's monster declares an attack while you control no monsters, Special Summons itself and Driver, destroys the attacker, and ENDS the Battle Phase!
PSY-Frame Circuit
Core Field Spell: whenever a 'PSY-Frame' monster is Special Summoned to your field, you can immediately Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster using only PSY-Frame monsters you control!
PSY-Frame Overload
Core Continuous Trap: once per turn banishes 1 'PSY-Frame' monster from hand or field to banish 1 card on the field FACE-DOWN; banishes itself from GY to add ANY 'PSY-Frame' card from Deck to hand!
PSY-Frame Accelerator
Continuous Trap: pays 500 LP to banish 1 PSY-Frame monster you control until next Standby Phase, clearing your field for handtraps and triggering Lambda's End Phase search!
Psychic Feel Zone
Returns 1 banished PSY-Framegear Tuner and 1 banished PSY-Frame Driver to your GY to Special Summon PSY-Framelord Zeta from your Extra Deck in Defense Position!
Hop Ear Squadron
Level 2 Tuner handtrap that lets you Quick-Synchro on the opponent's turn with lingering PSY-Frame Driver even without Circuit!
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches PSY-Frame Circuit.
extra: Signature Level 7 LIGHT Psychic Synchro boss (2500 ATK): Quick Effect once per turn to target 1 Special Summoned Attack monster and banish both that monster and this card until next Standby Phase, clearing your field for more handtraps!

Signature Link-2 LIGHT Psychic (2 non-Token monsters): while face-up on field, you can activate 'PSY-Framegear' monsters in your hand EVEN WHILE YOU CONTROL MONSTERS! Adds a PSY-Frame card during End Phase when a Psychic monster is banished!
Level 7 Synchro summoned during opponent's turn via PSY-Frame Circuit (using Level 1 Alpha/Beta + Level 6 Driver) to destroy all cards on the field!
Level 7 Synchro (Level 1 Alpha/Beta + Level 6 Driver) that negates an opponent's Spell/Trap Card or effect as a Quick Effect!
Level 8 Synchro that banishes an opponent's monster when it activates its effect!
Level 8 DARK Dragon Synchro that destroys all Special Summoned monsters with <= 3000 ATK and burns for each!
